subject.title: improve(ui): restyle composer send button as filled accent circle

question: Should the Control UI adopt this filled accent circle as the standard primary send treatment across chat and new-session surfaces?
rationale: The implementation appears coherent and proven, but choosing the permanent visual hierarchy for the primary chat action is a product and design judgment rather than a correctness question.

options.title: Adopt the filled treatment
options.body: Approve the demonstrated filled send-control family and merge after rebasing and exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Retain the outlined treatment
options.body: Decline this visual direction and keep the current outlined paper-plane control until a broader composer design pass.

recommendation.title: Adopt the filled treatment
recommendation.body: Approve the demonstrated filled send-control family and merge after rebasing and exact-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history and current work most strongly connect this person to Control UI behavior and this design direction.
